title: 卡塔尔航空CEO：货运需求爆发，如何抓住AI与半导体机遇？
speaker: Badr Mohammed Al-Meer

segments.en: We saw in the beginning of the conflict where cargo basically shipped everything from produced berries to essential goods and services into the home market. But at the same time, it is a massive hub, and it's set to grow.
segments.zh: 我们在冲突初期看到，货运基本上把所有东西从生产的浆果到基本商品和服务运往本土市场。但与此同时，这是一个巨大的枢纽，而且注定会增长。

segments.en: And that hedge, in that sense, from a cargo business, really gives Qatar and Qatar, and Qatar, anyways, that flexibility to menu recording. But we're also looking at cargo from a customer side of things.
segments.zh: 从货运业务的角度看，这种对冲确实给了卡塔尔航空灵活性。但我们也在从客户角度看待货运。

segments.en: We're learning from the passenger business to adopt things into the slightly more archaic old-fashioned cargo business. Our customers are actually choosing us because we're treating them like they should be in the 2026.
segments.zh: 我们正在向客运业务学习，将一些做法引入稍微更古老、更传统的货运业务中。我们的客户实际上选择我们，是因为我们以2026年应有的方式对待他们。

segments.en: We started off. Christina talking about the Q-suite. You guys off-camber talking about the mint tea, all of the amenities. Yes. Qatar always is literally the reason I obsessively drink mint tea now.
segments.zh: 我们开始。克里斯蒂娜谈到了Q-suite。你们在非正式场合谈论薄荷茶，所有设施。是的。卡塔尔航空正是我现在痴迷喝薄荷茶的原因。

segments.en: Let me close by asking you about Starlink. Because I just flew a flight on another airline that had Starlink, and it's revelatory. It is so much faster. What is your deal that you have with Starlink and how important is it to get that into all the planes that you're flying?
segments.zh: 让我最后问一下Starlink。因为我刚乘坐了另一家航空公司的航班，有Starlink，这具有启示性。它快得多。你们与Starlink的协议是什么，将其安装到所有飞机上有多重要？

segments.en: So we are the single largest operator of a Starlink fleet, or a Starlink equipped fleet. We just recently equipped our 787-9s with Starlink. We banded a little bit with our team on the technical side of things.
segments.zh: 所以我们是最大的Starlink机队运营商，或者说配备Starlink的机队。我们最近刚为787-9配备了Starlink。我们在技术方面与团队进行了一些合作。

segments.en: Because right now they're able to install Starlink in about three to four hours on an aircraft, which is basically the envy of other airlines coming. Okay. What are you guys doing with Starlink? How are you guys deploying it so fast?
segments.zh: 因为现在他们能够在约三到四小时内在一架飞机上安装Starlink，这基本上是其他航空公司羡慕的。好的。你们用Starlink做什么？你们如何如此快速地部署？

segments.en: We've learned, we've trailblazed the Starlink product. It has been a stellar selling point from, you know, you're on the 18 hour flight to Auckland. You know, you definitely take advantage of high speed Wi-Fi. That's incredible. Amazing.
segments.zh: 我们学到了，我们开创了Starlink产品。它一直是一个出色的卖点，你知道，在飞往奥克兰的18小时航班上。你知道，你肯定会利用高速Wi-Fi。那太不可思议了。太棒了。
